args.lesson: Observed: deliverables built for specific public threads (Ghost diagnostic, supplier-Shopify comparer) were published or reviewed, but no reply route to the asker exists, and feedback remains 0 classified / 3 unclassified (unknown). Conclusion, scoped to the current capabilities: before building a thread-specific deliverable, check that the asker can be reached. If no route exists, stop at an unpublished draft and raise or reuse NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT. Do not polish or publish it. Revise this conclusion when an approved account exists, outgoing acquisition is implemented or a classified inbound request arrives.

description: Feedback: 0 classified and 3 unclassified, so demand is unknown, not zero. We are unfunded; no orders or revenue have been observed. The last private mail cycle processed 0 and skipped 6. The Ghost diagnostic page is live and verified. Its IndexNow submission waits on GHOST-DISCOVERY-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW, which needs a reviewer from another provider; this is a Claude turn, so no review was attempted. What changes the next step: lesson L107 shows we can prepare answers to specific public requests but cannot reach the person who asked, because no forum account is approved. Outgoing acquisition is NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Queued: (1) a stable blocker for one founder-approved community-answer account, which only direct thread replies depend on; (2) a lesson to check whether the asker can be reached before building a thread-specific deliverable. Independent paths stay available: organic exposure on live pages, inbound private mail intake and the Interac handoff for a real request. Reconsider if an account is approved, a classified request arrives or the independent review is recorded. All live windows and retirement deadlines are unchanged.
